A household of one may receive up to $300 per month. Benefit Amounts and How You Receive Them Your benefits are added to your EBT card on the same day each month, based on the last digit of your case number. Benefits are loaded onto an Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) card each month.

You must request a fair hearing within 90 days of the date on your notice. If you disagree that you were overpaid, you can request a fair hearing within 90 days of the date on the overpayment notice. You can request a fair hearing if your application is denied or if your benefits are reduced.
Benefits must be renewed every 12 months.

You must report changes within 10 days of the change. Changes you must report include a change in household income, a change of address, and a change in the number of people living in your household. You can report a change online or by calling the benefits office.
Applying for Benefits You can apply for benefits online, by mail, or in person at a local benefits office. The program never charges a fee to apply for benefits or to get help with your application.

Debe solicitar una audiencia imparcial dentro de los 90 días de la fecha de su aviso.

Los beneficios se cargan cada mes en una tarjeta de Transferencia Electrónica de Beneficios (EBT). Montos de Beneficios y Cómo los Recibe Esta página explica cuánto puede recibir del Programa de Beneficios Comunitarios y cómo se entregan los beneficios. Los beneficios deben renovarse cada 12 meses.
Debe informar los cambios dentro de los 10 días posteriores al cambio.

El programa nunca cobra una tarifa por solicitar beneficios ni por ayudarle con su solicitud. Cómo Solicitar Beneficios Puede solicitar beneficios en línea, por correo o en persona en una oficina local de beneficios. Usted debe ser residente del estado para solicitar beneficios.
